# Flawless Dance & Fitness Studio

> Premier dance academy, cardio fitness centre, and choreography studio in Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai. Operating two specialized studio campuses (Sector 16 Main Flagship and Sector 5 Station Campus). Mentored by Director Avinash Mishra and National Hip Hop Gold Medalist Ankit Gupta.

## Studio Directory & Key Pages
- [Studio Homepage](https://flawlessstudio.in/): Official overview, campus highlights, video showcases, and admissions
- [Free Trial Pass](https://flawlessstudio.in/trial): Free 1st session booking terminal with real-time automated confirmation
- [Weekly Batch Schedule](https://flawlessstudio.in/schedule): Interactive daily timetable matrix by campus and discipline
- [Dance & Fitness Classes](https://flawlessstudio.in/classes): Bollywood, Zumba, Hip Hop, Contemporary, Kids Academy, and Yoga curriculum
- [Wedding & Sangeet Choreography](https://flawlessstudio.in/wedding): Couple dance, bride entries, family flashmobs, and music editing
- [Faculty & Mentors](https://flawlessstudio.in/team): Director Avinash Mishra and National Gold Medalist Ankit Gupta profiles
- [Studio Campuses](https://flawlessstudio.in/studios): Sector 16 Flagship and Sector 5 Station Campus acoustic specs and wooden sprung decks
- [Video Reels & Gallery](https://flawlessstudio.in/gallery): Student video reviews, rehearsal loops, and YouTube performances
- [FAQ & Guidelines](https://flawlessstudio.in/faq): Common beginner questions, trial etiquette, and non-refundable fees policy
- [Contact & Maps](https://flawlessstudio.in/contact): Campus Google Map locations, phone hotlines, and WhatsApp direct link
- [Privacy Policy](https://flawlessstudio.in/privacy): DPDP Act 2023 compliant data and rehearsal media policies
- [Terms of Service](https://flawlessstudio.in/terms): Studio floor regulations, footwear rules, and health waiver
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://flawlessstudio.in/refund): 100% non-refundable tuition policy and medical pause criteria
- [Cookie Policy](https://flawlessstudio.in/cookie-policy): Essential functional browser storage standards
